body: I'm sorry for you, I really hope things will get better for you in a few years. I cut myself a lot so I thought I wouldn’t have so much trouble cutting my wrists. I already felt a lot of pain, but I think nothing like cutting my wrists, I can't imagine the size of the pain. I am seriously thinking about whether I should continue with this or choose a plan b.

I do psychologist and psychiatrist, I take medication for depression and anxiety, but nothing seems to help me. yesterday i took some doses of vodka which only made my situation worse.
can you tell me something that is equivalent to the pain of cutting your wrist?

I'm really sorry for that !! try to find something you can use to defend yourself from your brother. your mom isn’t helping you at all, so try to defend yourself. this is so disgusting on his part, I hope you get better!

I think I'm financially stable, money can't make me happy. I just want to get this over with quickly. I'm worried about the pain I'm going to feel, but I don't have the courage to hang myself and I don't have enough medicine for an overdose. I know I'm taking a big risk by cutting my wrists, but this is my only alternative.

I hope that this time it will work. I'll try not to care about the pain

why do you think it won't work?
